authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the guide prints no Device Inquiry reply.

18 CC pair(s) are the coarse controller alone, 0 - 127: each pair is a controller and its partner 32 above, MIDI's coarse and fine, and the Circuit Mono Station's guide says the second "is used to create an 8-bit message for a 0-255 value range" without saying which bit it carries. Oscillator 1 Coarse (CC 14, fine CC 46); Oscillator 1 Fine (CC 15, fine CC 47); Oscillator 1 LFO2 > Pitch (CC 16, fine CC 48); Oscillator 2 Coarse (CC 17, fine CC 49); Oscillator 2 Fine (CC 18, fine CC 50); Oscillator 2 LFO2 > Pitch (CC 19, fine CC 51); Oscillator 3 Coarse (CC 20, fine CC 52); Oscillator 3 Fine (CC 21, fine CC 53); Oscillator 3 LFO2 > Pitch (CC 22, fine CC 54); Mixer Osc1 (CC 23, fine CC 55); Mixer Osc2 (CC 24, fine CC 56); Mixer Osc3 (CC 25, fine CC 57); Ring 1*2 Level (CC 26, fine CC 58); Noise Level (CC 27, fine CC 59); Filter Frequency (CC 29, fine CC 61); Filter LFO1 > Filter (CC 28, fine CC 60); LFO 1 Rate (CC 30, fine CC 62); LFO 2 Rate (CC 31, fine CC 63).
Left out, printed without a range: Effects Routing (NRPN 0:89), Chorus Type (NRPN 0:111).
Left out, not a control change or an NRPN (a program change, pitch bend, aftertouch, or none): Arp/Clock Rate (NA NA:NA).

Left out, printed without a control number: Mod Matrix 2 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 2 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 2 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 2 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 3 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 3 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 3 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 3 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 4 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 4 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 4 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 4 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 5 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 5 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 5 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 5 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 6 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 6 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 6 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 6 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 7 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 7 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 7 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 7 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 8 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 8 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 8 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 8 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 9 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 9 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 9 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 9 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 10 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 10 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 10 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 10 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 11 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 11 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 11 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 11 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 12 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 12 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 12 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 12 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 13 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 13 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 13 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 13 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 14 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 14 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 14 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 14 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 15 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 15 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 15 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 15 Destination (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 16 Source1 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 16 Source2 (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 16 Depth (NRPN ), Mod Matrix 16 Destination (NRPN ).
